headline: Friday on the lake: crisp fall air and steady fishing bite
lede: Friday, October 23 brings cool mornings, bright afternoons, and one of the better fishing windows of the week on Table Rock and Taneycomo. Pack layers and plan your day around the water.

plan.title: Table Rock sunrise fishing
plan.detail: Topwater bite on main lake points while water is still cool. Bass and crappie active.

plan.title: Explore the Strip or Taneycomo
plan.detail: Drive 76 Country Blvd or fish the trout parks below Table Rock Dam. Steady flows reported.
